ionic_negative_control: He+ 1s to 2p by two equal-helicity 0.75 photons is forbidden; evaluate old energy band and ionic m populations.
neutral_background: 0.75 a.u. is near the neutral-He 1s2p singlet-P excitation (~0.780 a.u.). At F0=0.1068 the mostly remaining neutral atoms can exhibit strong resonant excitation and multiphoton ionization. A nonzero or split NEW photoelectron band does not invalidate the ionic negative control.
